faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Will I receive a deed for the lot?
faq.a1: The development includes a deed-based sale and a legal package with a deed with retention of title, registry filing receipt and lien-free certificate. When the property deed is signed depends on your purchase option; your advisor will explain it.
faq.a2: How you acquire a lot depends on your situation and on applicable Mexican law. In the coastal zone it is usually a bank trust (fideicomiso). Ask your advisor and confirm it with your own attorney or notary.
faq.q3: Is financing or a payment plan available?
faq.a3: SOLARA offers different ways to acquire a lot. Your advisor will confirm current terms when you request your quote.
faq.q4: Can I build whenever I want?
faq.a4: The idea behind SOLARA is that you choose the timing: you can hold the lot and build later. Building is subject to the development's regulations and applicable permits, which your advisor will detail.
faq.q5: What infrastructure does the development have?
faq.a5: The development includes urban planning, internal streets, curbs and preparation for utility connections. Ask your advisor which services are available and at what stage.
faq.a6: Yes. Book a private tour or presentation with your advisor and set the format and date together.
faq.cta: Still have a question? Message us on WhatsApp
